description: This is a test class for the CurrentDateTimeAPI component within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin's API layer. It contains unit tests for the API's retrieval method and stub methods for update, delete, and their validation rules, checking for proper exception handling when operations are not implemented.

classes.name: CurrentDateTimeAPITest
